actual: simulation_runtime/scheduler.py:2029 run_once: when _run_binding raises DataUnavailableError/RuntimeConfigInvalidError and raise_on_error=False (the unattended background scheduler mode), the failure is ONLY appended to the in-memory results list (SimulationSchedulerBindingResult status=FAILED) returned in the transient SimulationSchedulerRunOnceResult; there is NO durable write (no create_run / save_run_event / save_error). So an active binding whose pre-run stage (selection/planning/config) fails produces no durable run and no operator-visible error -- a silent 'disappearing skip'. Likely root cause of LocalSim L16 today: active binding but no durable 2026-06-22 run/plan/selection evidence, portfolio stuck at 2026-06-17, no visible error. Violates no-silent-error rule.

No service start; no MiniQMT-logic change beyond shared durable-audit.

Keep per-binding isolation (one binding failure must not abort the whole tick) but make the failure durably auditable, not transient-only. Covers both LocalSim and MiniQMT bindings (shared run_once loop). No silent skip.
